title: What happens when you hit SEND on WhatsApp
caption:
What ACTUALLY happens when you hit send on WhatsApp 👇

1️⃣ Your phone encrypts the message with a key only your friend's phone can unlock (end-to-end encryption)
2️⃣ It travels to WhatsApp's servers over a connection your phone keeps open → ✓ one grey tick
3️⃣ The server can't read it, it only knows who it's for
4️⃣ Friend offline? The server holds it for up to 30 days
5️⃣ Their phone comes online → message pushed down + decrypted → ✓✓ two grey ticks
6️⃣ They open the chat → a tiny read receipt flies back → blue ticks

So if it's blue and there's no reply… not a tech problem 😅

Follow for more tech, under the hood ⚙️

#tech #whatsapp #howitworks #encryption #techexplained #programming #computerscience #softwareengineering #techfacts #underthehood

scenes.say: You hit send. In under a second, your message goes on a wild trip. Here's what actually happens.
First, your phone scrambles it. It gets encrypted with a key that only your friend's phone can unlock.
Then it shoots off to WhatsApp's servers, through a connection your phone keeps open all the time.
That's your first grey tick. And the server can't read it. All it sees is who it's for.
If your friend's phone is offline, the server holds onto it, for up to 30 days.
The moment their phone comes online, the message is pushed down and unlocked. Two grey ticks.
And when they open the chat, their phone fires a tiny receipt back to yours. Blue ticks.
So if it's blue, and they still haven't replied... that's not a tech problem. Follow for more tech, under the hood.
